rationale: Round 0 built and ran correctly with no ICE fallback, so this round escalates obfuscation intensity across all seven passes. FLA gets the highest SecurityGain (0.9) because the largest functions (Decode_Picture, Make_Spatial_Prediction_, form_component_prediction, main) are control-heavy decode/dispatch loops where flattening destroys the analyst's structural map; BCF and IBR follow closely to add opaque predicates and inter-block randomness on the same control-flow-rich code. SUB and IGV carry high DiversityGain since arithmetic-heavy hot kernels (IDCT, VLC decoding, motion compensation, reconstruction) benefit most from instruction substitution and global variable indirection, and IGV's low cost weights let it apply broadly with minimal overhead. ICALL stays strong (0.8) to obscure the decoder's call graph, with a moderate CorrectnessRisk weight since indirect calls in this C codebase are well-typed and low-risk. RuntimeCost and SizeCost weights sit at 0.4-0.6 overall — firm enough to keep heavy transforms off the tightest per-pixel loops, but relaxed from a defensive posture given the measured headroom; correctness weights stay low everywhere because the previous round showed no stability issues.
